correctness.rationale: For each positive power, S^n(S^n)^* is diagonal with exact descendants 1 plus the branching levels in a length-n spine window. Convexity of k^(1/alpha) bounds this window by n^alpha+O(1), while the root matches the order. Gaps diverge, so essential squared norm is exactly 2 for each fixed n. The norm-one right inverse of S gives surjectivity for all |lambda|<1 and the infinite independent sibling differences preserve infinite-dimensional kernels. Spectral radius one follows from the power formula. The Neumann resolvent upper bound is matched by an explicit unit vector on m~N^alpha disjoint infinite tooth rays, giving a lower norm ~N^(1+alpha/2). Nonsimilarity follows from noncomparable power growth rates. Code check_comb.py ran 2,946 finite diagnostics; no infinite claim relies on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: The construction is a natural, explicitly parameterized infinite class of unweighted parent shifts motivated by current Rota-universality research. It exhibits a structural separation between polynomially unbounded ordinary powers and bounded Calkin powers, preserves universality despite failure of a prior branch-disjointness assumption, and yields sharp resolvent growth exponents and continuum many nonsimilar examples with common essential-power norms. These are nontrivial operator invariants, not ad hoc numerical instances.
